claims.text: Ask the parent: something the child does that makes them proud; concerns about behavior, physical well-being or special health care needs; development or learning (walking, talking, drawing, writing name or ABCs); starting school and social or academic concerns; mood or behavior (attention, hitting, temper, worries, not playing with others, irritability, mood, activity level).
claims.quote: Tell me something your child does that makes you proud. • What are your concerns about your child’s behavioral, physical well-being, or special health care needs? • Do you have any concerns about your child’s development or learning (eg, walking, talking, drawing, or writing her name or ABCs)? • Do you have any concerns about your child starting school? What concerns do you have about her social or academic experience? • Please share any concerns about your child’s mood or behavior (eg, attention, hitting, temper, worries, not participating in play with others, irritability, mood, or activity level).
claims.locator: 5 and 6 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Past medical hx: any specialty or emergency care since the last visit.
claims.quote: received any specialty or emergency care since the last visit?
claims.locator: 5 and 6 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Family hx: any new health condition or death in the family; if yes, who has or had it, age at onset and diagnosis, or age at death.
claims.quote: developed a new health condition or died? If the answer is Yes: Ascertain who in the family has or had the condition, and ask about the age of onset and diagnosis. If the person is no longer living, ask about the age at the time of death.
claims.locator: 5 and 6 year visits, Health Supervision: History / Review of Systems

claims.text: Ask the child: do you think you are healthy, and what does healthy mean; something you're really good at.
claims.quote: Do you think you are healthy? • What do you mean when you say you are “healthy”? • Tell me something you’re really good at.

claims.text: ROS — any problems with: frequent headaches or dizziness; eyes or vision; ears or hearing; nose or throat; breathing problems or chest pain; belly pain, vomiting, urine or bowel problems; rashes; muscle aches, injury or other problems.
claims.quote: Does your child have any problems with • Regular or frequent headaches or dizziness • Eyes or vision • Ears or hearing • Nose or throat • Breathing problems or pains in chest • Belly aches or pains, throwing up, problems with urine or bowel movements • Rashes • Muscle aches, injury, or other problems
